The '''6783rd Troop Line''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Troop line|formation]]. It was part of the Imperial forces that invaded the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]] alongside the [[2391st Battle Squadron]] and the [[1249th Mobile Corps]].
